text:
olivia: Quick async sync on pricing/packaging v2 rollout — need to clarify owners and blockers for metering, billing mapping, quota enforcement, and contract constraints. Target canary window: Tue 09:00 PT next week. Main deps: metering adapter PR, billing plan-id mapping, quota schema bump, legal signoff for legacy contracts. Tagging: @kelly @sam @priya @david.

kelly: I can own the metering adapter. Will finish code review + tests today. Noted a missing metric for `cache_hits`, adding now.

sam: I’ll take billing mapping. One question: legacy plan ids — do we rewrite them or provide a mapping shim? Need list of legacy contracts that forbid automated remapping.

priya: Legal: we cannot change semantics for contracts that explicitly reference plan behavior. For contracts signed before 2022 (prefix LEG-2021.* and LEG-2020.*) we need explicit customer consent for plan behavior changes. I’ll pull the list and post it here by EOD tomorrow.

david: Infra note — quota enforcement v2 is on branch `quota/v2`. It requires the metering schema bump (minor version). If we flip schema now without a gate we risk breaking older clients. Recommend gating behind feature flag: `pricing.enable_v2 = true`.

olivia: OK — feature flag + canary sounds good. Can we do a 48h canary with automatic rollback on error rate > 1%? @deploy-bot can you schedule a canary when we give the go-ahead?

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled on request. CI build #234 for pricing-v2 passed :white_check_mark:. Waiting for manual trigger window.

kelly: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/metering/pull/432 — added tests + backfill script draft. @sam please review the rounding logic I added for token counts.

sam: Reviewing now. Left one comment about decimal rounding for cents -> micro-units mapping, and one about idempotency in the backfill script.

kelly: thanks — will address both. Quick config snippet I will add to the PR for the flag:
```yaml
pricing:
  enable_v2: true
  canary_percent: 10
```

priya: Heads up — if the backfill touches billing_amount fields we need a legal review before running it on customer data. Might push customer opt-in for a small subset.

david: I’ll prepare a rollback playbook and a databackup snapshot procedure. Also will update the observability dashboard to track: metering.ingest_errors, billing.mapping_errors, quota.enforced.

olivia: Action items (concise):
- kelly: finish & merge metering PR + include backfill script (aim EOD).
- sam: finalize billing mapping PR + response to rounding comment.
- priya: identify impacted legacy contracts and required opt-ins.
- david: prepare rollback + telemetry + docs stub.
Target freeze: Thurs 18:00 PT. If we hit all items, I’ll trigger the 48h canary.

kelly: :thumbsup: aiming for EOD. Quick Q — who owns customer-facing docs?

david: I’ll drop a short note in /docs/pricing/v2.md and add a changelog entry. Can follow up with a longer doc after merge.

sam: One more technical ask — migration/backfill might need a 30–60 minute migration window if we do synchronous webhook replays. Can we schedule during low traffic?

kelly: prefer avoid downtime — adding idempotent backfill so we can run in background.

priya: If the backfill updates billing fields, legal needs to sign off on the data transformation. That could push final go-live to EOD Wed depending on response.

olivia: Noted. If legal pushes, we delay the canary. Please ping me with blockers asap. Thanks everyone — will follow up with a short checklist in the morning. :white_check_mark:

kelly: adding final unit test run now.

sam: finishing PR review, will push changes within the hour.

david: snapshot scheduled and playbook in draft.

deploy-bot: Reminder: manual canary trigger required once all approvals are present.

olivia: Closing loop for now — if no blockers by EOD, I’ll schedule the canary and post the window here.
